errors.what: A chained Bash command (python edit + pkill) was refused whole by the pkill hook, so the --modes edit to eval/sroie-tesseractjs.mjs silently never ran; two SROIE Sauvola runs then read 0 scans before I noticed (about 10 min lost).
First design (Sauvola in place of --psm 4 on every photo) won on SRD but lost 11 totals on SROIE scans; replaced with a per-photo rule before shipping.

doc_friction.issue: The bracketed pkill hint is right, but the hook rejects the whole command line if the bare name appears anywhere else in it (e.g. an edited filename in the same command), which blocks unrelated steps chained with it; worth one line.

goal: Deepen the top flagship with a measured slice
notes: Unevenly lit receipt photos (lightSpread of a 32x32 grey thumbnail >= 0.13) now get tesseract's Sauvola threshold for the second reading of each image instead of --psm 4, page and CLI. certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
